name: Facet
text: Implement a dark theme by default with a highly visible light-theme toggle. A dark theme reduces eye strain during long sessions and makes vibrant data visualizations pop, improving clarity and enjoyment. The toggle keeps accessibility intact for users who prefer light interfaces or work in bright environments. Trade-off: some users may initially resist the dark default, but the toggle mitigates that risk without sacrificing the benefits.

name: Pane

The toggle risks becoming an afterthought, leading to inconsistent usage and potential confusion among users. A better alternative is to conduct user testing to determine the preferred theme based on actual user behavior rather than assumptions.
